name: CommerceBird – AI Support & Sales Agents, Helpdesk and B2B for WooCommerce
author: CommerceBird

sections.description:
AI agents that support your shoppers and sell for you

Start the 30-day trial on commercebird.com.

CommerceBird puts two AI agents on your WooCommerce store. A support agent answers questions, looks up orders and hands hard cases to your team as tickets. A sales agent helps shoppers choose, fills their cart and takes B2B quote requests.

Shoppers talk to them in a modern chat widget on your store. You create, train and manage each agent in the CommerceBird app, and this plugin connects them to your store: it shows the right widget on the right page, adds products to the cart, and keeps your tickets in your own WordPress.

One agent for support, one for sales

Each store can have a support agent and a sales agent. Each one has its own:

  • name, logo, brand colour and greeting
  • suggested questions and chat placeholder
  • instructions, so you set its tone and rules
  • actions: what it is allowed to do
  • knowledge: which of your Q&A entries and store pages it may use
  • chat widget, with its own Live switch

You choose where each widget appears: on every page, on shop and product pages, or on My Account and the help pages you pick. When both agents could appear, the sales agent shows on shop pages and the support agent everywhere else. Neither appears on cart or checkout.

Support agent

  • Answers product questions with live prices and stock from your store
  • Looks up order status safely: only with the order’s billing email, or automatically for signed-in customers
  • Answers policy questions from your own Q&A and store pages (returns, shipping, warranty and more)
  • Accepts photos from shoppers, for example of a damaged product (up to 3 per message)
  • Creates a ticket for your team when it can’t help, or when the shopper asks for a person

Sales agent

  • Recommends products and compares them side by side
  • Shows product cards with an “Add to cart” button
  • Sends ready-made cart and checkout links, so shoppers go straight to paying
  • Captures leads (name, email, company and what they’re looking for) and emails them to your sales team
  • Takes B2B quote requests: it creates an order with the status “On quote” for you to review and send. The agent never sets prices or discounts.

A helpdesk that lives in your store

Tickets, replies and photos are stored in your own WordPress, so you keep them even if you stop using CommerceBird.

  • Answer tickets in the CommerceBird Helpdesk, with the chat transcript, the shopper’s photos, internal notes, status, priority and assignee
  • Or answer them in WP admin under CommerceBird › Tickets
  • Your store sends every ticket email itself, in your WooCommerce email template and in the shopper’s language
  • Customers reply on a private ticket page on your store; signed-in customers also find their tickets under My Account › Support tickets
  • Photos are kept private, hidden from the Media Library, and deleted for good when the ticket is solved
  • Leads and quote requests from the sales agent are listed under Helpdesk › Leads

Test first, then go live

Try each agent in the Playground before you switch it on. Playground leads are marked “Test”, and quotes there are only previews, so nothing reaches your orders.

Speaks your shoppers’ language

The chat widget comes in English, German, Spanish, French, Dutch and Portuguese and follows your store’s language. The agents answer in the language the shopper writes in.

Costs under control

Agents use your CommerceBird AI credits. Set a daily limit per agent, and built-in rate limits and bot protection keep abuse from eating your credits.

Run your whole WooCommerce business from one place

The agents are part of the CommerceBird platform, which also gives you:

  • Multi-store dashboard — manage all your WooCommerce stores from one fast interface
  • AI assistant for merchants — create orders, update products and get store analytics and recommendations by chatting, through native WooCommerce MCP
  • Frontend AI blocks — Product Review Summary, Dynamic FAQ and Q&A blocks that help shoppers decide faster on the product page
  • Certified 2-way integrations — Zoho Inventory, Zoho CRM and Exact Online, kept in sync in real time
  • Quotes — create, send and convert quotes from your dashboard, including the ones your sales agent creates
  • Purchase orders — create and automate POs from low stock, out of stock or straight from an order; ideal for dropshipping
  • Advanced product import — import tens of thousands of products in the background from any CSV format
  • Support for popular plugins — WPML, WC Subscriptions, Product Bundles, ACF, PDF Invoices, Sequential Order Numbers and more

B2B features, no other plugin needed

  • Works with any WooCommerce site, new or established, B2B or hybrid B2C/B2B
  • One product, different prices, discounts and tiered pricing
  • Works with all WooCommerce payment and shipping methods
  • Access control: set visibility by group, hide prices, categories, brands or the whole website
  • Custom fields in the registration form, billing address and checkout
  • Extended and dedicated registration forms, with registration approval
  • Request a quote, invoice payment and purchase order payment
  • Wholesale quick order form and live search
  • Different shipping methods, payment methods and minimum order amounts per group
  • HPOS compatible
  • No coding required

Terms: TOS
Privacy Policy: Privacy Policy

⏩ Use of 3rd Party Services

To provide its features, CommerceBird uses the following services when the feature is enabled:

  • CommerceBird (commercebird.com) for the AI agents: when an agent is live, its chat widget is loaded from commercebird.com, and shopper messages are sent to CommerceBird, which stores the conversations, leads and the knowledge you add. Photos are uploaded straight to your store. – TOS and Privacy Policy
  • AI model providers, through the Vercel AI Gateway, to generate the agents’ answers and search your knowledge – TOS and Privacy Policy
  • Zoho CRM and Inventory API to synchronize Orders, Products and Customers – TOS and Privacy Policy
  • Exact Online API to synchronize Orders, Products and Customers – TOS and Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
To install CommerceBird, follow these steps:

  1. Download and activate the plugin
  2. Go to Pricing and subscribe for the trial
  3. Click on the “next steps” button to visit the my account page
  4. Open a new browser tab and connect your domain to our App
  5. Click on the Copy Token button
  6. Go to your store’s wp-admin menu > commercebird > paste the subscription id, token and your e-mail address and click save!
sections.faq:
Q: What can the AI agents do?

A: The support agent answers product and policy questions, looks up order status and creates tickets for your team. The sales agent recommends and compares products, sends cart and checkout links, captures leads and takes B2B quote requests. You switch each action on or off per agent.

Q: How many agents can I create?

A: One support agent and one sales agent per store. Each has its own settings, knowledge, actions and chat widget.

Q: Do I need a paid plan?

A: The AI agents and the Helpdesk need a paid CommerceBird plan. The plugin itself, the dashboard and the core Zoho sync work with a free account on commercebird.com. The Exact Online integration needs the Premium plan.

Q: How do I add the chat widget to my store?

A: Create the agent in the CommerceBird app, open its Deploy page, choose where it should appear and click “Save and send to store”, then switch it Live. No code is needed: this plugin adds the widget to the right pages. Make sure the plugin is up to date.

Q: Can I choose on which pages the chat appears?

A: Yes. Show each agent on every page, on shop and product pages, or on My Account and the help pages you pick. The chat never appears on cart or checkout.

Q: Can the agent see my customers’ orders?

A: Only safely. A shopper gets an order’s status only after giving the billing email of that order, or automatically when signed in to their own account.

Q: Can the sales agent change prices or give discounts?

A: No. Cart links and quotes always use the prices WooCommerce calculates. Quotes are created with the status “On quote” for you to review before sending.

Q: Where are tickets stored?

A: In your own WordPress: tickets, replies and photos stay in your store, also if you disconnect CommerceBird. You can answer them in the CommerceBird Helpdesk or in WP admin under CommerceBird › Tickets.

Q: How do customers reply to a ticket?

A: Every ticket email links to a private ticket page on your store where they can read the thread and reply. Signed-in customers also see their tickets under My Account › Support tickets.

Q: Which languages do the agents speak?

A: The chat widget is available in English, German, Spanish, French, Dutch and Portuguese and follows your store’s language. The agents answer in the shopper’s language, and ticket emails go out in the language the shopper chatted in.

Q: What do the agents cost?

A: They use the AI credits of your CommerceBird account. Set a daily limit per agent to keep costs predictable.

Q: Can I test an agent before it goes live?

A: Yes. Every agent has a Playground. Leads from the Playground are marked “Test” and quotes there are only previews.

Q: Is my WooCommerce data safe with CommerceBird?

A: Yes. Your products, orders and customers stay in WooCommerce: the app works through the WooCommerce API. Tickets and photos are stored in your own store. To run the agents, CommerceBird stores the chat conversations, leads and the knowledge you add.

Q: Which product types does it support?

A: Simple, Variable, Bundles, Simple Subscription & Variable Subscription.

Q: Is it compatible with the WPML plugin?

A: Yes, this plugin has no compatibility issues with WPML.

Q: Can I create Purchase Orders?

A: Yes! You can even create a PO from an order or from a list of low-stock and out-of-stock products.

Q: Which integrations does it support?

A: Zoho CRM, Zoho Inventory and Exact Online. The core Zoho sync works on the Free plan; the advanced integration features need the Premium plan. Please check the Pricing for more info.

Q: Do the integrations support Guest orders?

A: Yes, all our integrations support guest orders.

Q: Where can I see the documentation and contact support?

A: Please visit the Support site to read the docs and open a support ticket. For plugin-specific issues, please open an issue here on wordpress.org.
